people.name: Arad
people.line: Arad, Canaanite city, attacked Israel, later inhabited by Kenites

people.name: Atharim
people.line: A place where the Canaanite king of Arad fought Israel.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
translations.bsb: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.
translations.kjv: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
translations.asv: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who dwelt in the South, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
